items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser
items.content:
Checking agent-generated code usually means hopping between tabs. Learn how to view diffs, run terminal commands, and preview web apps side by side in the GitHub Copilot app.

The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Checking agent-generated code usually means hopping between tabs. Learn how to view diffs, run terminal commands, and preview web apps side by side in the GitHub Copilot app.
The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Kayla Cinnamon

summaries.zh: GitHub Copilot应用入门指南：使用diff、终端和浏览器功能。该应用支持在GitHub Copilot中同时查看代码diff、运行终端命令和预览网页应用，方便用户在多个任务间高效切换。通过这些功能，用户可以更便捷地管理代码和项目。
summaries.en: The GitHub Copilot app allows beginners to efficiently view diffs, run terminal commands, and preview web apps side by side. This integration reduces the need to switch tabs, streamlining the coding process. The app enhances productivity by providing a unified interface for these essential tasks. For more details, refer to "GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser" on The GitHub Blog.

items.title: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
items.content:
In controlled offline evaluations, HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline while reducing estimated workflow cost. Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.

The post Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
In controlled offline evaluations, HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline while reducing estimated workflow cost. Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.
The post Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: GitHub Staff

summaries.zh: 项目HydraFusion通过多模型编排实现前沿质量。在离线测试中，其选择性编码工作流程表现与Opus 5基准持平或更优，同时降低工作流程成本。目前已在GitHub Copilot中作为研究预览发布。
summaries.en: Project HydraFusion achieves frontier quality through multi-model orchestration. In offline evaluations, its selective coding workflows matched or exceeded Opus 5 performance while reducing workflow costs. Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality
items.content:
Why shorter outputs can cost more, and how GitHub Copilot reduces wasted work across the complete coding task.

The post How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Why shorter outputs can cost more, and how GitHub Copilot reduces wasted work across the complete coding task.
The post How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Erik Kristensen

summaries.zh: 本文探讨了如何通过GitHub Copilot提升AI编码的成本效益，同时不牺牲任务质量。文章指出，较短的输出可能因重复请求导致成本增加，而GitHub Copilot通过优化整个编码流程，减少了不必要的重复工作，从而提高了成本效率。
summaries.en: GitHub Copilot enhances AI coding efficiency by reducing wasted work and optimizing output length, ensuring cost-effectiveness without compromising task quality. The blog explains how shorter outputs can sometimes incur higher costs and details Copilot's approach to minimizing unnecessary work across the entire coding process.

items.summary: 本文探讨了如何通过GitHub Copilot提升AI编码的成本效益，同时不牺牲任务质量。文章指出，较短的输出可能因重复请求导致成本增加，而GitHub Copilot通过优化整个编码流程，减少了不必要的重复工作，从而提高了成本效率。
